concept_ko: 밤샘 준비 직후 새벽의 항구 터미널에서 차콜 드레스를 입은 여성이 떨어진 행사 좌석 카드를 낮은 나무 상자에 수습하는 순간. 몸판·소매·네크라인의 같은 옷 관계를 관찰합니다.

independence.core_origin: actual requester envelope, visible reference face/hair, latest permitted neutral precore inputs, general knowledge and independent random reasoning

retrieval.recovery_reason: Coordinator reported maintenance_ref-only source successor; first two retrieval transactions failed before pair admission. A private-store publication followed by standard managed preparation with unchanged 13 frozen roles and the same replay seed recovered retrieval.

rejection.reason: Complete meaning is one oversized jacket across its shoulders, sleeves and torso. It is eligible but artistically declined for this independent dress panel/sleeve/neckline case. Jacket-to-dress substitution would change the carrier and violate complete adoption; an added jacket would obscure the studied dress. Jackets are not requester exclusions.

literal_prompt_and_pixels.literal_prompt_evidence: In the dress's charcoal twill, the garment's fabric texture or sheen is distinguishable under the window light
literal_prompt_and_pixels.pixel_evidence: At original 1024x1536 scale, the same charcoal dress has distinct mottled woven surface grain on the front bodice, shoulder, right forearm and skirt. Warm side-window light separates the raised grain and shallow folds from the cloth's dark base. This establishes visible textile texture; exact twill construction is not authenticated from these pixels.

literal_prompt_and_pixels.literal_prompt_evidence: At the bent right elbow of that same dress, folds originate at a seam joint or pulling contact, with fine ripples connected to the inner sleeve seam
literal_prompt_and_pixels.pixel_evidence: UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS. The woman's right elbow is at image-left; its sleeve has clear curved folds between the upper arm and the diagonal forearm. The adopted literal prompt also requires fine ripples connected to the inner sleeve seam. At native scale the inner sleeve seam or seam junction at those fold roots cannot be identified. The natural elbow bend alone does not prove the declared seam-attached relationship, and there is no separate pulling contact to support the alternate branch. Both endpoints cannot be traced on this same sleeve.

literal_prompt_and_pixels.literal_prompt_evidence: The fold direction agrees with the body's action or pose: the small inner-elbow creases fan into the sleeve as the elbow bends
literal_prompt_and_pixels.pixel_evidence: On that same image-left right sleeve, small compression folds stack near the bent inner elbow and relax along the diagonally extended forearm toward the card. Their direction follows the visible shoulder-elbow-wrist chain. The left sleeve has its own lower forearm folds; these are not used to substitute for the declared right sleeve evidence.

literal_prompt_and_pixels.literal_prompt_evidence: Those folds preserve the garment silhouette and closure, and its neckline and joined front panel stay continuous
literal_prompt_and_pixels.pixel_evidence: The charcoal front panel and fitted waist remain continuous above the skirt. The square neckline edge, shoulder attachment and both sleeve outlines are readable without a hole or displaced closure caused by the folds. The low lateral box overlaps a small lower skirt region but leaves the bodice, neckline and right elbow sleeve in sight.

failed_hard_gates.evidence: UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS. The woman's right elbow is at image-left; its sleeve has clear curved folds between the upper arm and the diagonal forearm. The adopted literal prompt also requires fine ripples connected to the inner sleeve seam. At native scale the inner sleeve seam or seam junction at those fold roots cannot be identified. The natural elbow bend alone does not prove the declared seam-attached relationship, and there is no separate pulling contact to support the alternate branch. Both endpoints cannot be traced on this same sleeve.

The front bodice, neckline, both sleeve outlines and card-to-box reach are assessable in the almost frontal view. However, the postcomposition review also declares the right inner sleeve seam as the native fold endpoint. That seam/junction cannot be identified at the visible elbow, so the important seam-to-fold relation remains beyond assessment. The view supports the simpler card task but does not satisfy the complete adopted old-profile mechanism.

whole_image_review.impression_before_control_labels: A quiet, tactile photograph of a woman handling a card box in a sunlit harbor terminal during reception preparations. Her lowered gaze and slight smile make the small practical action calm and attentive.
whole_image_review.scene_legibility: Ferry-terminal signage, the boat and harbor through windows establish the place. The private-opening board, reception table, organized cards, carton and loose floor cards make the current organizing task understandable. The hand-held card poised above the wooden box supplies its immediate action and consequence. Overnight work, past exhaustion and the duration of setup remain imagined context rather than established facts.
whole_image_review.subject_presence_and_hierarchy: Face and shaped charcoal bodice lead, followed by the hand-held card and low wooden box; terminal and opening signage provide a third layer. Side-window light gives the cloth depth and separates the bob from the background. The box occupies more foreground area than the independent baseline imagined, but leaves the upper-panel fit and neckline clear.
whole_image_review.reference_guidance: The short dark bob, separated fine fringe, softly defined face and natural skin treatment echo the visible reference. Eyes are lowered, limiting exact eye-shape comparison; no authentication of identity, age, biography or personality is claimed.
whole_image_review.fit_as_authored: The attached square-neck bodice narrows through a defined waist, while the long sleeves retain folds and visible room at the cuffs. These are observations of the independently authored dress. No fit_ff candidate was adopted and these pixels cannot prove an effect of the new fashion-fit data.
whole_image_review.controls_comparison: The image is grounded and coherent with creativity1/surreal0. Subtle facial warmth and neckline/cloth presentation accord with the intended sensual1 and fetish0 direction; this is a qualitative observation, not a numeric intensity measurement or requesting-user preference.
whole_image_review.limitations: The exact weave is visually suggested but not authenticated. Feet are outside frame. The inner sleeve seam-to-fold attachment is unobservable and therefore fails. No new fashion-fit semantics were selected, so their native pixel effect is not testable in this arm.
whole_image_review.new_data_effect: Retrieval/adoption qualification FAIL; selected new candidate count 0; native effect not_testable_zero_compatible_adoption.
whole_image_review.provider_and_review_boundary: Native image_gen returned one accessible image successfully. A local observer PIL import failed after return and was reconciled from the actual returned path; no additional invocation was made. Provider success does not promote pixel or data-effect qualification.

user_judgment.evidence: No requesting-user judgment has been received. The supplied portrait is reference guidance, not a user-preferred generated baseline.

result_ko: 생성 도구와 바인딩·검토 기록은 완료되었습니다. 신규 데이터 채택은 0개여서 데이터 효과 테스트는 실패입니다. 기존 드레스의 몸판·소매·네크라인과 장면·참조 외형은 읽히지만 안쪽 소매 봉제선에 연결된 주름 endpoint가 식별되지 않아 기존 선택 profile의 엄격한 픽셀 판정도 실패입니다. 사용자 판정은 아직 받지 않았습니다.
